# TokenOps Atlas

> The open reference for FinOps-style visibility, allocation, optimization, and governance of LLM token spend.

TokenOps Atlas is a public, vendor-neutral guide to running large language model
token and credit spend as an engineered operating discipline. It covers the full
lifecycle: discovering usage, baselining cost, defining allocation rules,
optimizing prompts and models, and operationalizing governance.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the TokenOps operating model.
- [About](/about): What TokenOps Atlas is and who it's for.
- [Operating manual](/guide): The complete TokenOps guide in one page.
- [Implementation roadmap](/roadmap): Discover, measure, govern, optimize, scale.
- [Optimize hub](/optimize): Entry point to every optimization surface.
- [Techniques catalog](/techniques): Full library of token-saving techniques.
- [Tool-specific guides](/tool-guides): Playbooks for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, Lovable, and more.
- [Caveman compression](/caveman): The telegram-style prompt method.
- [Prompt templates](/prompt-templates): Copy-paste scaffolds and checklists.
- [Optimization patterns](/patterns): Reusable recipes for reducing waste.
- [Toolkit](/toolkit): Interactive tools and calculators overview.
- [Cost calculator](/calculator): Model spend calculator.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Sample operational dashboard.
- [Hub](/hub): Calculators, glossary, and operating manual entry.
- [Glossary](/glossary): TokenOps terminology.
- [Content library](/library): 29 guides, playbooks, checklists, references, and templates.
- [Resources](/resources): Documents and starter artifacts.
- [Templates](/templates): Starter operating artifacts.
- [Sources](/sources): Reference material.
